# NXLabTW

> NXLabTW is a Taiwan-based technology team specializing in website development, web application security testing, and practical software products.

## Official website

- [NXLabTW](https://nxlabtw.com/): Company, services, projects, official profiles, and contact information.

## Services

- Website development for small companies, independent teams, and organizations.
- Web application security assessments and penetration testing.
- Service inquiries: service@nxlabtw.com

## Projects

- [AstraNote](https://astranote.nxlabtw.com/): Free online notebook available across devices.
- [Neutron — ACMTN](https://neutron.nxlabtw.com/): Private, browser-encrypted conversations through the Advanced Confidential Message Transfer Network.
- [Browzen](https://github.com/NeuralNexusLab-nh/Browzen): Privacy-conscious Chromium-based Windows browser.
- [WebTNX](https://webtnx.nxlabtw.com/): Lightweight HTTP tunnelling.
- [NexaCAPTCHA](https://nexacaptcha.nxlabtw.com/): Static image-based human verification.
